processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: FastAPI service exposed on the internet that receives requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE that we expose on the internet

processes.name: model server
processes.description: Server that runs the actual model, loads model artifacts, and reads customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: Bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network. Redis has no password on it

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery

trust_boundaries.description: GKE environment where the inference gateway runs.

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: Network containing the model server's GPU nodes and the Redis feature store.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: GPU nodes in our model network
trust_boundaries.notes: The model network is intended to be reachable only from the gateway.

trust_boundaries.name: different cloud
trust_boundaries.description: Cloud environment containing two of the calling services.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: two of the calling services are in a different cloud

assumptions.assumption: The model registry bucket contains commercially sensitive model artifacts, so its data classification is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The bucket stores model artifacts, which are business-sensitive system data.

assumptions.assumption: The Redis feature store is confidential because it contains customer-specific features.
assumptions.basis: The source states that features include account age and spend bands per customer.

assumptions.assumption: The inference log is confidential because it contains raw prompts that may contain information entered by users.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever users typed.

assumptions.assumption: The different cloud boundary is controlled by a different hosting party from the system's own environment.
assumptions.basis: The source states that two calling services are in a different cloud; this is modeled as a tenant boundary.
